court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation, Ripon Building and Others
case_number: WP No. 17350 of 2026 and W.M.P. No. 18625 of 2026
advocates: For Petitioners : Mr. G. Ashokapathy for M/s. Pass Associates
For Respondents : Mr. E.C. Ramesh, Standing Counsel, (GCC), for R 1 and R 2
Mr. B. Sanjay Balachandar, Standing Counsel, (CMDA) for R 3
judgment_text:
Prayer : Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of mandamus forbearing Respondents 1 and 2 from constructing or permitting any permanent structure in OSR-lands measuring an extent of 1214.53 sq.m in T.S. Nos. 113/3, 113/4 and 113/5 and B. No. 65 Padikuppam Road, Chennai, Respondent 3 from granting or regularizing any approval, and Respondent 4 from supporting or advocating construction in the OSR land of Pace Prana Apartments, and to direct all Respondents to maintain the land strictly as open space.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Sounthar, J.:— By consent of both the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as respondents, this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage itself.

2. The Writ Petition has been filed to issue writ of mandamus, forbearing the respondents 1 and 2 from constructing or permitting any permanent structure in OSR Lands measuring an extent of 1214.53 sq.m in T.S. Nos. 113/3, 113/4 and 113/5 and B. No. 65 Padikuppam Road, Chennai.

3. Mr E.C. Ramesh, learned Standing Counsel (GCC) takes notice for the respondents 1 and 2 and Mr B. Sanjay Balachandar, learned Standing Counsel (CMDA) takes notice for the 3rd respondent.

4. When the writ petition is taken up for hearing, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents would submit that the respondents have not given any permission for construction of permanent structure in OSR Lands. The said submission made by the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents is recorded.

5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands disposed of. No costs. Consequently, the connected writ miscellaneous petition is closed.
